message.content:
There are 22 people, and each person can shake hands with at most 20 others.

If everyone shook hands with everyone else, the total number of handshakes would be

\[
\binom{22}{2}=\frac{22\cdot 21}{2}=231.
\]

But each person is allowed at most 20 handshakes, while in the complete graph each person would shake hands with 21 others. So each person must “miss” at least one handshake.

To reduce every person’s handshake count by at least 1, we can remove a perfect matching of 11 handshakes: pair up all 22 people and remove the handshake between each pair. Then each person loses exactly 1 handshake, so each now has at most 20.

Thus the maximum number of handshakes is

\[
231-11=220.
\]

The answer is 220.
